title: Docs and words for Link: tools, concepts section, glossary, vocabulary, design/link.md Native peer
description:
## Intent
Documentation and words for the native peer.

## Steps
1. `docs/tools.md`: `apricity play … --link [--quantum N] [--no-start-stop] [--latency MS]` and `apricity link [--seconds S]` in "The `apricity` command", with what each message means.
2. `docs/concepts.md`: new section "Playing beside a DAW over Link": what Link shares (tempo, beat in the bar, start/stop) and doesn't (song position, time signature); bar 1 lands on a session bar line; Apricity only follows; audio goes out through your own interface or a loopback driver.
3. `docs/glossary.md`: Link, Link session, peer, quantum, phase, start/stop sync (alphabetical, in the existing `###` style).
4. `design/vocabulary.md`: the same words in "The words" table (the DAW's word column says "Link" where it matches), and a line on why "sync" and "follow" are not used alone.
5. `design/link.md`: "Native peer" section.

## Verify
`npm --prefix web run build` (the Docs tab renders the markdown); `grep -n "### Link" docs/glossary.md`.

Commit: `docs(<this task id>): Link in the docs`.

## Protocol
Specs first, watched red; log decisions, problems and outcomes with `kbs comment`; run Verify and paste the tail. Every Bash call starts `export PATH=$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH && cd /Users/home/Projects/Apricity`; cargo with `CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 RUST_TEST_THREADS=2` under `safe-run.sh --`. Never change dependencies to make a build pass. Sub-agents never commit, push or close.
